title: Chapter 361 Everyone Meets
content:
Chapter 361 Everyone Meets

"Stop arguing!"

Jiang Mu yelled, his face gloomy.

He was in a very unhappy mood. Could it be that he couldn't handle such a small scene?

Growing up, his brother's talents were higher than his own, and he was taken care of by his brother in everything.

Although his brother was very kind to him, this also led to him living in his brother's shadow.

Now, he has broken through the top military generals and is finally close to catching up with his brother.

He wanted to be like his brother, someone who could stand alone.

At a fork just now, he and his brother got separated.

At first, he was a little panicked, but then he became excited.

Without his brother by his side, he felt the breath of freedom.

This is a rare opportunity, a chance to prove your strength.

I must make some achievements to show my brother.

I am not a flower in the greenhouse.

"I don't want to say it a second time, you go ahead."

Jiang Mu's voice was cold and emotionless.

Swann tugged on Wang Cuilian's sleeve and whispered: "A good man doesn't suffer the immediate consequences."

Wang Cuilian thought for a while and then swallowed.

At this time, the numbers and combat power were at an absolute disadvantage, and it was impossible for our group to unite as one.

"Okay, let's go explore the road first."

Wang Cuilian's move made many people in the team extremely disappointed. Although her decision should be extremely correct, she just couldn't accept it emotionally.

At this point, the team's cohesion declined again.

Wang Shuo also followed Wang Cuilian and walked to another passage.

For Wang Shuo, it might be better to go ahead. At least he can discover good things or dangers earlier and take action earlier.

In this way, the group began to continue exploring.

These passages are much wider than before.

Most places can accommodate four or five people passing through abreast.

There were also a large number of claw marks left by unknown creatures on the stone walls on both sides of the passage, which made everyone a little frightened.

Suddenly, with the help of the weak firelight, Wang Shuo saw a white shadow not far ahead, flashing past.

Wang Shuo thought he was dazzled, so he asked Lin Yao beside him: "Lin Yao, did you see anything?"

Lin Yao said in a panic: "Did you see it too? I thought I was hallucinating?"

After hearing Lin Yao's words, Wang Shuo shook the Weeping Blood Gun in his hand.

It is inconvenient to use long weapons in the cave, so he deliberately picked up a knife on the way just now. Although it is not a golden weapon, it can at least add some psychological comfort.

After walking a few more steps, Wang Shuo heard another sound, which sounded like the breathing of some strange beast.

This made Wang Shuo even more uneasy. It seemed that a battle was coming.

After passing through a cave entrance covered with vines, everyone came to a larger cave.

At this time, there were already some people in the cave, and they were in a confrontation.

This space is very huge, covering thousands of square meters.

On a high platform in the center, there was a dream-like thing, emitting a soft light.

Because of the hazy light, it was hard to see clearly what it was.

But this did not hinder everyone's desire for it at all, and everyone's eyes showed undisguised greed.

Even Wang Shuo is no exception.

Then more people came in.

Around the high platform, including the entire cave hall, were covered with bones, weapons, armor, and even stored treasures scattered randomly.

Just now, everyone's eyes were attracted by the glowing treasures on the high platform, but they did not notice what was under the high platform.

Obviously, these bones were their original owners, and the tense atmosphere made everyone afraid to act rashly to a certain extent.

Wang Shuo had an ominous premonition in his heart. Why did everyone gather here?

Is there something guiding you?
